key: Get away from me. You both reek of hypocrisy.
en: Get away from me. You both reek of hypocrisy.
ja: 近寄らないで。二人とも　偽善の匂いが　するわ。

key: Whether it's the spirit or the psyche...
en: Whether it's the spirit or the psyche...
ja: 精神であれ　心であれ……

key: Both can break in time.
en: Both can break in time.
ja: どちらも　いずれ　壊れる。

key: I would have thought twice about taking this job if I knew I'd be facing you again.
en: I would have thought twice about taking this job if I knew I'd be facing you again.
ja: また　お前らと　やり合うと　わかってたら　この仕事　引き受けるのを　考え直してたわ。

key: There's not much point in a battle like that.
en: There's not much point in a battle like that.
ja: あんなバトル　あんまり　意味　ないわね。

key: I learned that much from the first fight I saw you in at the Orphanage.
en: I learned that much from the first fight I saw you in at the Orphanage.
ja: 孤児院で　初めて　あなたの戦いを　見たときに　それくらいは　学んだもの。

key: One of the superiors gave us a little bit of info on her.
en: One of the superiors gave us a little bit of info on her.
ja: 上の人間から　彼女について　少し　情報を　もらったの。

key: Well, all of you.
en: Well, all of you.
ja: というか　あなたたち　全員について　だけど。

key: I guess some of them decided to put it to use.
en: I guess some of them decided to put it to use.
ja: それを　活用しようって　思ったやつも　いたみたいね。

key: METEOR: It would be a shame if all this persistence went to waste now, wouldn't it?
en: METEOR: It would be a shame if all this persistence went to waste now, wouldn't it?
ja: メテオ: これだけの粘り強さが　むだになるのは　もったいないと　思わないか?

key: VICTORIA: The only thing that'll be wasted is Team Meteor!
en: VICTORIA: The only thing that'll be wasted is Team Meteor!
ja: ヴィクトリア: むだに　なるのは　メテオ団のほうよ!

key: METEOR: Is that the attitude that you teach down at that tawdry school?
en: METEOR: Is that the attitude that you teach down at that tawdry school?
ja: メテオ: それが　あの安っぽい学校で　教えてる態度なのか?

key: VICTORIA: I'll be happy to give you a lesson right now!
en: VICTORIA: I'll be happy to give you a lesson right now!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 今すぐ　レッスンを　してあげてもいいわよ!

key: So violence is your answer.
en: So violence is your answer.
ja: ハワヤ: つまり　暴力が　お前の答えってわけか。

key: Defiant as ever, aren't you?
en: Defiant as ever, aren't you?
ja: キャリー: 相変わらず　反抗的ね。

key: ARC: Can you two hear me on this thing?
en: ARC: Can you two hear me on this thing?
ja: アーク: 二人とも　これ　聞こえてるか?

key: I heard fighting from down here. Are you all right?
en: I heard fighting from down here. Are you all right?
ja: ここから　戦う音が　聞こえたぜ。無事か?

key: VICTORIA: Yeah, we're fine!
en: VICTORIA: Yeah, we're fine!
ja: ヴィクトリア: ええ　平気よ!

key: Didn't I tell you? There's no way I'll lose to Team Meteor ever again!
en: Didn't I tell you? There's no way I'll lose to Team Meteor ever again!
ja: 言ったでしょ? もう二度と　メテオ団になんて　負けないんだから!

key: ARC: That's music to my ears.
en: ARC: That's music to my ears.
ja: アーク: そいつは　いい響きだ。

key: VICTORIA: There's another one of those floors up here. Can you handle it?
en: VICTORIA: There's another one of those floors up here. Can you handle it?
ja: ヴィクトリア: ここにも　あの床が　もう一つ　あるわ。お願い　できる?

key: ARC: It's not even a factor. You know what to do, \PN.
en: ARC: It's not even a factor. You know what to do, \PN.
ja: アーク: 造作もねぇ。やることは　わかってるな\PN。

key: VICTORIA: Just what purpose does this kind of thing serve anyway?
en: VICTORIA: Just what purpose does this kind of thing serve anyway?
ja: ヴィクトリア: そもそも　こんなもの　何のために　あるわけ?

key: I can't imagine it was put here just to slow us down.
en: I can't imagine it was put here just to slow us down.
ja: あたしたちを　足止めするためだけに　置かれてるとも　思えないし。

key: METEOR: How much longer do you intend to flounder around in affairs well beyond your ability?
en: METEOR: How much longer do you intend to flounder around in affairs well beyond your ability?
ja: メテオ: いつまで　自分の手には　余る事態で　もがき続けるつもりだ?

key: VICTORIA: You wanna see just how far this ability goes?
en: VICTORIA: You wanna see just how far this ability goes?
ja: ヴィクトリア: この「手に余る」がどこまでのものか　見てみたい?

key: METEOR: Ah, is someone getting riled up? What would Kiki think?
en: METEOR: Ah, is someone getting riled up? What would Kiki think?
ja: メテオ: おや　カッとなってるのか? キキなら　何て言うだろうな?

key: VICTORIA: Don't you dare act like you know her!
en: VICTORIA: Don't you dare act like you know her!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 彼女を知ってるみたいな顔　しないでよ!

key: As long as you side with Team Meteor, you're not even fit to speak her name!
en: As long as you side with Team Meteor, you're not even fit to speak her name!
ja: メテオ団の側に　立ってる限り　あんたに　彼女の名前を　口にする資格なんて　ないんだから!

key: You're already faltering.
en: You're already faltering.
ja: ダニエール: もう　ぐらついてるじゃない。

key: Is Kiki smiling right now?
en: Is Kiki smiling right now?
ja: ラムジー: 今頃　キキは　笑ってるだろうな。

key: VICTORIA: Say her name one more time and see what happens.
en: VICTORIA: Say her name one more time and see what happens.
ja: ヴィクトリア: もう一度　彼女の名前を　言ってみなさいよ　どうなるか　見てあげる。

key: METEOR: Hmm.
en: METEOR: Hmm.
ja: メテオ: ふむ。

key: Is that what Kiki wants?
en: Is that what Kiki wants?
ja: それが　キキの　望むことか?

key: METEOR: Well, even I can't say he didn't deserve that.
en: METEOR: Well, even I can't say he didn't deserve that.
ja: メテオ: まあ　あいつが　それに　値したことは　私にも　否定できないな。

key: VICTORIA: ...Let's go.
en: VICTORIA: ...Let's go.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……行くわよ。

key: No response.
en: No response.
ja: 反応は　ない。
